source_fidelity: Read-only preview of native booking/contact reconciliation contracts on Tours.dev. No native SettingsService writes, auto-schedule, wp_mail, option updates, user mail exposure or Form #6 mutation.
rationale: Existing native Fluent Forms notification settings remain untouched. The new company-admin GET readback resolves site-enrolled sender identity and current native form references. It reports exact managed feed and source hash, source/recipient drift and review blockers without revealing recipient addresses, body, subject, or traveler submissions. Read-only fixtures assert PII minimization, foreign company and stale binding denial, duplicate feed refusal, WordPress administrator-only access, no SMTP dispatch, no create/update/delete and no WordPress cron. The four existing live write/scheduler functions remain intentionally absent until separately authorized.
